steps.what: Show related special education meetings throughout the district.
Participate in activities, attending meetings and providing support to educators.

tasks.design: The {CALENDAR} store shows the special education meeting already on the record. The education administrator participates in those activities, attends the meetings, and provides support to special educators throughout the district. The stored meeting does not attend, and it does not decide a placement. A meeting with no record leaves the support with the administrator.
tasks.previous_blocker: Support was marked given because a meeting sat on the calendar, and the administrator had not attended.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored meeting can be opened. The support for special educators still has to be given in person.
tasks.still_hard: A concern the record does not state still has to be heard in the meeting.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator attends and supports the educators. The calendar line is only the record already stored.
tasks.altitude: The meeting stays with the administrator and the educators. The stored line is only visible.

reach.task: Receive support in the meeting this administrator attends.
reach.learn: A calendar line is not support.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored meeting is a lookup. It does not attend the meeting or support the educators.
A placement or admission decision is not made by a screen. The people in the meeting make it.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An education administrator in a mid-size European school group. A stored record is not the decision, and a draft is not the accepted version.

Fields: The meeting id and the meeting already stored. The screen does not mark support as given and does not decide a placement. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the education administrator finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the stored meeting before the administrator attends.
unknowns: Whether special education meetings and ordinary staff meetings share one calendar.
research_questions: Who must be in the meeting before support to a special educator is called given?

already_counted.description: Attending the meeting and supporting educators stays with the administrator.

incremental.description: Drop meetings whose record has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The administrator still participates in special education meetings and supports educators throughout the district. Only opening a meeting that was already stored is removed. A calendar line saves none of that support.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Prepare attendance, activity, and planning records from stored rows.
Maintain and oversee preparation and maintenance of personnel reports.
File the accepted attendance, activity, and planning report.

tasks.design: The {DATA_PLATFORM} store assembles attendance, activity, planning, and personnel rows that are already stored. The education administrator oversees the preparation and maintenance of the report and accepts it. The screen does not score staff and does not turn attendance into a behaviour roster. A missing row is omitted, not invented. The register that already stores attendance is not this labour.
tasks.previous_blocker: A report was filed from a copy the administrator had not checked, and a blank row was filled with a guess.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored attendance and activity rows can be copied into one report. The administrator still oversees it.
tasks.still_hard: A row the register does not hold still has to be left out, and the administrator still accepts the report.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator maintains and oversees the report. The screen only copies rows already stored.
tasks.altitude: Oversight of the report stays with the administrator. Copying stored rows is the only part removed.

reach.task: Keep the attendance row this report copies.
reach.learn: A report line is not a new attendance mark.

evidence.claim: Copying stored attendance and activity rows into a report is deterministic. A missing row is omitted.
An attendance report is not a staff score and not a behaviour roster. The administrator still oversees it.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An education administrator in a mid-size European school group. A stored record is not the decision, and a draft is not the accepted version.

Fields: A stored attendance row, activity row, planning row, or personnel row, each with its id. A missing row is omitted. The screen does not score a person. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the education administrator finishes it by hand.
Native check: Copy a row only when its id is already stored. Do not invent a count.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the education administrator.
The attendance register already stores attendance. That runtime is not this labour. The report does not score staff or build a behaviour roster.
unknowns: Whether attendance, activity, planning, and personnel rows share one register.
research_questions: Which stored row types may appear in this report, and who accepts it before filing?

already_counted.description: Overseeing and maintaining the report stays with the administrator.

incremental.description: Retire a report whose source rows were withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: attendance report accepted by the education administrator

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The administrator still oversees preparation and maintenance of attendance, activity, planning, and personnel reports. Only copying rows that were already stored, and filing the accepted report, is removed. The register that already stores attendance is not this labour, and the report does not score staff.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the stored program and service the action concerns.
Recommend personnel actions related to programs and services.

tasks.design: The {HCM} store shows the program and service the action concerns. The education administrator recommends the personnel action and accepts that recommendation. The screen does not hire, dismiss, or score anyone. The {DOCS} store files only the accepted recommendation. A recommendation is not the personnel action.
tasks.previous_blocker: A personnel action was treated as decided because a program name was on file, and no one had recommended it.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored program can be opened. The recommendation still has to be made by the administrator.
tasks.still_hard: Whether a person should move, stay, or leave is still the administrator's judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator recommends the action. The screen only shows the program already stored.
tasks.altitude: The recommendation stays with the administrator. Opening the program and filing the accepted text are the only parts removed.

reach.task: Receive a recommendation this administrator has accepted.
reach.learn: A program name is not a personnel action.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored program is a lookup. It does not recommend a personnel action.
Hiring, dismissal, and staff scoring are decisions a person makes. A screen must not make them.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An education administrator in a mid-size European school group. A stored record is not the decision, and a draft is not the accepted version.

Fields: The program id and the service already stored. The screen does not hire, dismiss, or score a person. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the education administrator finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the program before the administrator writes the recommendation.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the education administrator.
The screen does not hire, dismiss, or score a person. A recommendation is not the action.
unknowns: Whether the recommendation is stored with the program or in a separate personnel file.
research_questions: Who else must see a personnel recommendation before it is acted on?

already_counted.description: Recommending the personnel action stays with the administrator.

incremental.description: Withdraw a recommendation whose program record was closed.

approvals.approved_version: personnel recommendation accepted by the education administrator

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The administrator still recommends personnel actions related to programs and services. Only opening the stored program and filing the accepted recommendation is removed. The screen does not hire, dismiss, or score anyone.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show stored policies the administrator reads to stay abreast.
Discuss improvements for education programs with federal, state, and local agencies.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the education policies already held. The education administrator meets federal, state, and local agencies, stays abreast of those policies, and discusses improvements for education programs. The stored policy does not hold that meeting. A policy with no record leaves the discussion with the administrator.
tasks.previous_blocker: An improvement was treated as agreed because a policy was on file, and the agency had not been met.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored policy can be opened. The discussion with the agency still has to happen.
tasks.still_hard: What an agency will accept is still said in the meeting, not in the stored policy.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator discusses the improvements. The policy is only the text already held.
tasks.altitude: The agency meeting stays with the administrator. The stored policy is only visible.

reach.task: Discuss program improvements with this administrator.
reach.learn: A stored policy is not the discussion.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored policy is a lookup. It does not meet an agency or agree an improvement.
A discussion with a public agency is a conversation. A stored policy does not hold it.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An education administrator in a mid-size European school group. A stored record is not the decision, and a draft is not the accepted version.

Fields: The policy id and the policy text already stored. The screen does not record an agreement the meeting did not reach. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the education administrator finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the policy before the meeting. Do not treat the policy as the discussion.
unknowns: Whether federal, state, and local policies share one file.
research_questions: Which agency must be in the meeting before an improvement is called discussed?

already_counted.description: Discussing improvements with agencies stays with the administrator.

incremental.description: Drop a policy whose record has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The administrator still meets federal, state, and local agencies and discusses improvements for education programs. Only opening a policy that was already stored is removed. A stored policy saves none of that discussion.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The education administrator still joins special education meetings, still recommends personnel actions, and still discusses improvements with agencies. A stored record can be opened. It does not make those calls.
reach: Special educators meet this administrator in person. A calendar line is not that support.
Agencies hear program improvements from this administrator, not from a stored policy.
skills_to_grow: Join the special education meeting. A stored agenda is not the support.
Recommend a personnel action as the administrator's own decision. The screen does not hire or score.
Oversee a report assembled from stored rows. The report does not evaluate staff.
role.ambitious_version: Meetings, personnel recommendations, agency discussions, and oversight of records stay with the administrator. A stored row only shows what a person already recorded.
